item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 16/May/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A dry easterly airstream will bring mainly fine weather to the coast of Guangdong today and tomorrow. Under the influence of an upper-air disturbance, there will be a few showers over southern China over the weekend. A broad trough of low pressure is expected to affect the northern part of the South China Sea and the coast of Guangdong early to midweek next week. The weather will be unsettled with showers and thunderstorms over the region.
